This condition impairs lung development, leading to underdeveloped lungs (pulmonary hypoplasia), which results in respiratory distress shortly after birth. The retrieved evidence path supports this by linking congenital absence of kidneys to anhydramnios and oligohydramnios, confirming the consensus that the lack of amniotic fluid due to renal agenesis is the underlying cause of the respiratory issues.
